en: Today a new moon is in the sky a 23 inch metal sphere placed in orbit by a Russian rocket. Here an artist's conception of how the feet was accomplished. A three-stage rocket. Number one, the booster in the class of an intercontinental missile.
zh: 今天天空中有一個新月，一個23英寸的金屬球體由俄羅斯火箭送入軌道。這裡是一位藝術家對這項壯舉的想像。一枚三段式火箭。第一段是洲際飛彈級的助推器。
ja: 今日は新しい月が空にあります。23インチの金属球体がロシアのロケットによって軌道に乗せられました。ここでは、その偉業がどのように達成されたかを芸術家が想像しています。三段式ロケットの第一段は、大陸間ミサイル級のブースターです。
local: Today a new moon is in the sky a 23 inch metal sphere placed in orbit by a Russian rocket. Here an artist's conception of how the feet was accomplished. A three-stage rocket. Number one, the booster in the class of an intercontinental missile.
ja_pron: Kyou wa atarashii tsuki ga sora ni arimasu. 23 inchi no kinzoku kyūtai ga Roshia no roketto ni yotte kidou ni noseraremashita. Koko de wa, sono igyou ga dono you ni tassei sareta ka o geijutsuka ga souzou shiteimasu. Sandan-shiki roketto no dai ichi dan wa, tairikikan misairu-kyū no būsutā desu.
native: Today a new moon is in the sky a 23 inch metal sphere placed in orbit by a Russian rocket. Here an artist's conception of how the feet was accomplished. A three-stage rocket. Number one, the booster in the class of an intercontinental missile.

en: It's weight estimated at 50 tons. The smaller second stage took over at 5000 miles an hour and carried on to the highest point reached.
zh: 它的重量估計為50噸。較小的第二段以每小時5000英里的速度接手，繼續前進到達最高點。
ja: その重さは約50トンと推定されています。より小さな第二段が時速5000マイルで引き継ぎ、到達した最高点まで運びました。
local: It's weight estimated at 50 tons. The smaller second stage took over at 5000 miles an hour and carried on to the highest point reached.
ja_pron: Sono omosa wa yaku 50 ton to suitei sareteimasu. Yori chiisana dainidan ga jisoku 5000 mairu de hikitsugi, toutatsu shita saikōten made hakobimashita.
native: It's weight estimated at 50 tons. The smaller second stage took over at 5000 miles an hour and carried on to the highest point reached.

en: 500 miles up the artificial moon is boosted to a speed counterbalancing the pull of gravity and released.
zh: 在500英里高空，人工月球被加速到一個抵消重力拉力的速度，然後釋放。
ja: 高度500マイルで人工の月は重力の引力を相殺する速度まで加速され、放たれました。
local: 500 miles up the artificial moon is boosted to a speed counterbalancing the pull of gravity and released.
ja_pron: Kōdo 500 mairu de jinkō no tsuki wa jūryoku no inryoku o sōsai suru sokudo made kasoku sare, hanataremashita.
native: 500 miles up the artificial moon is boosted to a speed counterbalancing the pull of gravity and released.

en: You are hearing the actual signals transmitted by the earth circling satellite. One of the great scientific feats of the age.
zh: 你正在聽到由繞地球衛星傳送的實際信號。這是這個時代偉大的科學壯舉之一。
ja: あなたは地球を周回する衛星から送信される実際の信号を聞いています。これはこの時代の偉大な科学的偉業の一つです。
local: You are hearing the actual signals transmitted by the earth circling satellite. One of the great scientific feats of the age.
ja_pron: Anata wa chikyū o shūkai suru eisei kara sōshin sareru jissai no shingō o kiiteimasu. Kore wa kono jidai no idaina kagakuteki igyō no hitotsu desu.
native: You are hearing the actual signals transmitted by the earth circling satellite. One of the great scientific feats of the age.
